article.story: WICHITA, Kan. -- — Will Berg scored 19 points and Wichita State beat Texas A&M-Corpus Christi 91-73 on Monday. Berg also grabbed 10 rebounds for the Shockers (6-1). Kenyon Giles scored 18 points, shooting 7 for 14, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc. Jordan Frison shot 6 of 8 from the field and 4 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 17 points. Daniel Michelini-Jackson finished with 20 points for the Islanders (2-5). Desmond Kent Jr. added 12 points and five assists, while Mekhi Wallace pitched in with 10 points and two blocks. Wichita State took the lead for good with 15:57 remaining in the first half. The score was 36-29 at halftime, with Bryce Heard racking up 12 points. Wichita State extended its lead to 50-35 during the second half, fueled by an 11-2 scoring run. Giles scored a team-high 16 points in the second half as their team closed out the win. Up next: Wichita State takes on Kentucky on the road on Friday, and Texas A&M-Corpus Christi hosts Southwestern Adventist on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
